prompt.text:
Create a new, rendering-independent profile transformation module. Export `ProfileSource`, `BiographyLine`, `ProfileView`, and `buildProfileView(source)`. The image identifier must be trimmed and nonempty. Biography entries must each be trimmed and nonempty; an empty biography array is valid. Preserve paragraph order. Each output line contains the trimmed text and a stable unique key: the first occurrence uses the text itself, and later duplicates use `text#2`, `text#3`, and so on. Validation failure throws `TypeError`. The function must neither mutate nor retain aliases to its input, and every returned nested object must be newly created.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
